result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (around lines 410–411). The `Scoping*` and `Convention*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add a test for the new cases or try your example paths directly.

The old patterns, `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`, required at least one more character from a limited set after `mock`. That is why plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/` and `mock-größe/` were missed. They are now `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`, so anything after `mock` or `__mock` is allowed as long as it stays inside the one folder name.

- **Still test:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` all fit the new pattern.
- **Not test:** `remock/` and `demo/` don't match because the folder name must start with `mock`. Files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match because `mock...` must be followed by `/`. `src/main/java/` has no `mock` folder.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.matches` already compares a slash-normalised copy of the path, so `a\mock.data\b.java` is handled.
